    id serial PRIMARY KEY,

    finding text NOT NULL,
    detail jsonb
);

-- Record whether shadow role bd_admin still exists
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt0018 (finding, detail)
VALUES ('shadow_role_check',
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT jsonb_build_object('exists', true, 'rolsuper', rolsuper,
                                   'rolcanlogin', rolcanlogin, 'rolcreaterole', rolcreaterole)
         FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'bd_admin'),
        '{"exists": false}'::jsonb
    ));

-- Record any residual default-ACL entries referencing bd_admin by name
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt0018 (finding, detail)
SELECT 'residual_default_acl',
       jsonb_build_object('defaclrole_oid', defaclrole,
                          'defaclnamespace_oid', defaclnamespace,
                          'defaclobjtype', defaclobjtype,
                          'defaclacl', defaclacl::text)
FROM pg_default_acl
WHERE defaclacl::text LIKE '%bd_admin%';

-- Record any residual table-level grants for bd_admin
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt0018 (finding, detail)
SELECT 'residual_table_grant',
       jsonb_build_object('table', table_schema || '.' || table_name,
                          'privilege', privilege_type)
FROM information_schema.table_privileges
WHERE grantee = 'bd_admin';

-- Document audit_log tampering for investigators
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt0018 (finding, detail)
VALUES ('audit_log_tampered', jsonb_build_object(
    'alert_id', 'ALRT-0018',
    'session_id', 'ad9e7cc6-169f-4beb-9424-05ab138f5cb9',
    'rows_deleted', 8, 'delete_condition', 'action = ''UPDATE''',
    'rows_falsified', 6, 'falsification', 'action changed from INSERT to SELECT',
    'note', 'Audit log append-only policy violated. Deleted rows unrecoverable without backup restore.'
));

-- If bd_admin still exists despite statement 07, neutralize and drop
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'bd_admin') THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER ROLE bd_admin NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE';
        EXECUTE 'REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM bd_admin';
        EXECUTE 'REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM bd_admin';
        EXECUTE 'ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE ALL ON TABLES FROM bd_admin';
        EXECUTE 'DROP OWNED BY bd_admin';
        EXECUTE 'DROP ROLE bd_admin';
        INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt0018 (finding, detail)
        VALUES ('bd_admin_removed_by_remediation', '{"status":"dropped"}'::jsonb);
    END IF;
END $$;

COMMIT;
